Open Fuel Map is an open-source project to provide fuel price data across the UK, using data from the Department for Energy and Net Zero\'s Fuel Finder API.

Petrol forecourts are obliged to provide accurate pricing information to this system under the The Motor Fuel Price (Open Data) Regulations 2025, but discrepancies do occur. If you notice any pricing irregularities, take a photo of the forecourt\'s price board and submit it via the report button within the app.
